questions.name: var-basic
questions.question: a custom property on body is read by var() on a child
questions.rcss: body { --c: #ff0000; } #a { position: absolute; left: 0dp; top: 0dp; width: 100dp; height: 100dp; background-color: var(--c); }

questions.name: var-fallback
questions.question: var() with a fallback uses it when the property is not declared
questions.rcss: #a { position: absolute; left: 0dp; top: 0dp; width: 100dp; height: 100dp; background-color: var(--nothing, #00ff00); }

questions.name: var-unresolved
questions.question: var() with no declaration and no fallback drops the declaration (ground shows through)
questions.rcss: #a { position: absolute; left: 0dp; top: 0dp; width: 100dp; height: 100dp; background-color: var(--nothing); }
warnings: Error: [RmlUi] Invalid substitution, variable '--nothing' not defined. In element: div#a < body < #root#shared

questions.name: var-inherits
questions.question: a custom property declared on an ancestor reaches a grandchild
questions.rcss: #o { --c: #ff0000; position: absolute; left: 0dp; top: 0dp; width: 100dp; height: 100dp; } #m { display: block; } #a { position: absolute; left: 0dp; top: 0dp; width: 100dp; height: 100dp; background-color: var(--c); }

questions.name: var-override
questions.question: a closer declaration overrides an inherited one
questions.rcss: body { --c: #ff0000; } #o { --c: #0000ff; position: absolute; left: 0dp; top: 0dp; width: 100dp; height: 100dp; } #a { position: absolute; left: 0dp; top: 0dp; width: 100dp; height: 100dp; background-color: var(--c); }

questions.name: var-length
questions.question: a length token through var() sizes a box (width: var(--w) with --w: 50dp)
questions.rcss: body { --w: 50dp; } #a { position: absolute; left: 0dp; top: 0dp; height: 100dp; width: var(--w); background-color: #ff0000; }

questions.name: var-in-shorthand
questions.question: var() inside a shorthand (margin: 0dp 0dp 0dp var(--gap)) is expanded
questions.rcss: body { --gap: 20dp; } #a { display: block; width: 50dp; height: 50dp; margin: 0dp 0dp 0dp var(--gap); background-color: #ff0000; }

questions.name: var-in-decorator
questions.question: var() inside a decorator's colour list (horizontal-gradient(var(--c1) var(--c2)))
questions.rcss: body { --c1: #ff0000; --c2: #0000ff; } #a { position: absolute; left: 0dp; top: 0dp; width: 100dp; height: 100dp; decorator: horizontal-gradient(var(--c1) var(--c2)); }

questions.name: var-whole-value-list
questions.question: a custom property holding a whole value list (--f: 'Montserrat') is usable as font-family through var()
questions.rcss: body { --f: Montserrat; } #a { position: absolute; left: 0dp; top: 0dp; width: 100dp; height: 100dp; font-family: var(--f); font-size: 40dp; color: #ff0000; }

questions.name: var-cycle
questions.question: two custom properties that reference each other are refused (the declaration drops, the fallback is not used)
questions.rcss: body { --x: var(--y); --y: var(--x); } #a { position: absolute; left: 0dp; top: 0dp; width: 100dp; height: 100dp; background-color: var(--x, #00ff00); }
warnings: Error: [RmlUi] Invalid substitution, cycle detected with variable: --y. In element: body < #root#shared

questions.name: var-transition
questions.question: a property whose value comes from var() still transitions when the variable changes by a class
questions.rcss: body { --w: 20dp; } #a { position: absolute; left: 0dp; top: 0dp; height: 100dp; width: var(--w); background-color: #ff0000; transition: width 1.0s linear-in-out; } #a.big { --w: 80dp; }

questions.name: var-token-sheet
questions.question: every token declared on body by the layer's own forms, one read back by var(--surface-panel) (the generated sheet's shape)
questions.rcss: #a { position: absolute; left: 0dp; top: 0dp; width: 100dp; height: 100dp; background-color: var(--surface-panel); }
